featured_reviews.name: Vijay Kumbhoje
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Yoga House is a fantastic place to learn and practice yoga for improving one's health and wellbeing. The studio is located in a serene and peaceful environment that provides the perfect atmosphere for yoga practice. From the moment you step in, you are welcomed with warm hospitality and a sense of calm that instantly makes you feel at ease.

The instructors at The Yoga House are knowledgeable, skilled, and passionate about sharing the benefits of yoga with their students. They are well-trained in a variety of yoga styles and are adept at tailoring the practice to the individual needs of each student. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced practitioner, the instructors are committed to helping you achieve your health goals.

The classes are held in a spacious, well-lit studio with plenty of natural light and fresh air. The equipment and props are clean, well-maintained, and readily available, ensuring a comfortable and safe practice. The class sizes are small, which allows for more individual attention from the instructor, making it easier to learn and progress in your practice.

The Yoga House offers a range of classes, from gentle and restorative to more challenging and dynamic styles, all of which focus on improving flexibility, strength, and balance, as well as reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The variety of classes ensures that there is something for everyone, regardless of age or fitness level.

In conclusion, The Yoga House is an excellent place to learn and practice yoga for health benefits. The studio's welcoming atmosphere, skilled instructors, and well-equipped facilities make it a top choice for anyone looking to improve their physical and mental health through the practice of yoga. I highly recommend it to anyone who is interested in experiencing the transformative power of yoga.

featured_reviews.name: mohsin vadgama
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly Recommend!!!
Airborne Fitness: where workouts are so entertaining, even the dumbbells crack jokes. The vibe is so good, the trainers could lead a laughter aerial class. I've never had a class here that felt as dull as a lecture on lint. I count down the days like it's a workweek, but instead of TGIF, it's Thank Goodness It's Fitness Friday! I'm practically waiting for Saturday like it's the weekend at a 8 to 9. South Mumbai's got a few aerial studios, but Airborne swoops in and steals the show. It's not just a place; it's a positivity party hosted by fitness wizards. Oh, and let's not forget that one magical class where they hit us with a nostalgia bomb, and suddenly we were sweating it out to all the Backstreet Boys hits. And to top it off, they could consider turning everyone into the next big thing in aerial workouts—because why settle for just hanging when you can swing your way to fitness glory.

Trust me, it's not Spin Doctor, it's Captain Jack Sparrow steering the ship to a healthier, happier us!
#AirborneFunFitness
#AirborneArialJoy

featured_reviews.name: Aritra Pal
featured_reviews.review_text: Ambience and practice ground is really good. Mumbai being a place which attracts a lot of cost for anything except vadapav, for the services it provides, it is costly for any class you register for. If pocket permits then can select this as an option.

featured_reviews.name: Sanika Shetye
featured_reviews.review_text:
Airborne has been around for five years and I have been working out with them for three years. I have been practising aerial fitness and CrossFit here. Also started with stick mobility recently.

The studio offers a variety of fitness programs. A team of trained professionals ensures that you are being taught correctly and taken care of.

What I love the most about training here is that it is a happy, safe space with a sense of belongingness. Conventional gyms or workout studios generally lack warmth. There's a formal trainer-client relationship. However at Airborne, Zamina Ladiwala and Dharmesh Chheda have successfully built a community. A community that celebrates fitness together.

Head to the studio's Instagram page (airborneaerialfitness) for full details of the schedule and more details. It is an active page and the admins respond to queries posted.

featured_reviews.name: Ishita Desai

I'd been practicing yoga with Divya since 2019 and more recently, practicing Ashtanga with Deepa. From just a weekly class, it has become the most vital part of my life. Both Divya and Deepa encourage self-practice and work extremely hard to create an environment where it's easily possible.
Whether you are sick, on your period or just having a rough day, they modify asanas to enable you to continue with the practice without hampering your health. Practicing yoga has many benefits. But practicing with Divya and Deepa leaves you feeling rested, refreshed and ready to take on anything life throws at you.

featured_reviews.review_text: Deepa mam (my 1st yoga guru)is one of the best yoga teacher. She is not only passionate but patient with her students. featured_reviews.review_text: Divya's yoga classes are a breath of fresh air. Her instruction is excellent and I was able to correct a lot of things I was doing wrong. 10/10 would recommend to anyone who wants to practice yoga :)

featured_reviews.name: RaghavP Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text:
This gym is pretty decent overall, especially if you're focused purely on getting your workout in. It has a wide variety of equipment—everything from free weights to machines and cardio gear. So in terms of equipment availability, they've got most things covered.

However, the major drawback is the layout. The space is quite congested, with machines and benches stuffed in tightly, leaving very little room to move around. At peak hours, it can get uncomfortably crowded, and you often find yourself waiting for equipment or awkwardly navigating through narrow gaps between machines.

Cleanliness and maintenance are okay, and the staff and the trainer are polite and professional. The crowd is generally focused, which is nice, but the overcrowding does impact the overall experience, especially for those who like a bit more breathing room while working out.

If you go during off-peak hours, it's much more manageable. So, it’s a good gym for the price and equipment, but space and crowding could definitely be improved.
